notes: Represents the three near-identical *-download-from-oracle.sas scripts (encounter, hospital, patient_type), which share one PROC SQL 'create table ... select * from or_link.&table_name' + PROC EXPORT dbms=csv pattern over an Oracle libname needing live EHR credentials. This bundle stands a small in-memory patient_type table in for the Oracle source so the same SQL-into-table and CSV-export logic runs anywhere. Deterministic across repeat runs.
